archive_policy: Complete scalar streams are stored losslessly as gzip. Selected and checked valid/indeterminate candidate poses and SVGs are repository-managed. Raw uncompressed run directories remain under ignored runs/audit.
timing_policy: Main throughput includes GPU initialization and full-budget compression, measured at synchronized boundaries and CUDA events. Compilation, warm-up, transfers, validation and output are separate. External run_call_seconds includes final summary serialization.
